name: brother
description: Turn a plain-language outcome into checked work, a rerunnable receipt, useful local memory, and a human acceptance decision.

interface.shortDescription: Checked work with a receipt you can rerun.
interface.longDescription: Brother reads what a piece of work actually is, applies the right amount of checking, and leaves a rerunnable receipt, local memory of what was learned, and a human acceptance decision. It keeps PASS, FAIL and NO-DATA distinct, so missing evidence stays visible instead of reading as a pass.
defaultPrompt: Check this migration before I merge it.
Explain why last week's report number looks wrong.
Set up a receipt for the work I am about to start.
